title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
summary: A man wakes alone on a spaceship with no memory and slowly pieces together that he is humanity's last hope. Solving the problem takes science, nerve and an unexpected friend.
readIf: You like problem-solving stories where the science is explained clearly and the tone stays warm.
skipIf: You want lyrical prose or deep character study over puzzles.

pairings.reason: Another story about people holding on to hope, with a quiet, literary feel in place of the puzzle-solving.
A much denser science-fiction classic if you want politics and ideas on a grand scale.
